The '''Ord Cantrell system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]].
